# Boring Internet: AI crawler guide

## What this site is
Boring Internet is a directory for people who want to discover websites without algorithmic feeds. Pages are curated by hand and organized so visitors can move website to website quickly.

## Core pages to index

1) Home directory
- Path: /
- Focus: broad discovery, category filtering, featured links, launches, and internal navigation
- Query intent: discover websites, find websites, bored button alternatives

2) Discover websites
- Path: /discover-websites
- Focus: direct discovery path for visitors who want to jump between sites
- Query intent: website to website, discover websites

3) New and upcoming websites
- Path: /new-websites
- Focus: latest launches and recent additions
- Query intent: new and upcoming websites, launch new websites

4) Trending
- Path: /trending
- Focus: currently popular sites based on voting
- Query intent: trending websites, discover websites

5) Collections
- Path: /collections
- Focus: grouped sets of related websites
- Query intent: curated website lists, find websites by theme

6) Blog
- Path: /blog
- Focus: editorial explanations of curation and launch decisions

7) Submit
- Path: /submit
- Focus: how creators submit launched websites for review

## Crawl notes
- Public pages are static and indexable.
- /admin is intentionally blocked in robots directives.
- Sitemap includes all core listing routes, collection pages, and blog posts.
